meta.title: Config sync Plus
meta.description: Back up your DSH profile to a GitHub Gist. In Settings → Built-in plugins → Config sync Plus, preview file changes and missing plugins, then confirm to restore and install. Use a trusted Gist; undo restores configuration only, not packages.

title: Config sync Plus
subtitle: Back up this profile or preview a restore from a trusted GitHub Gist.
pluginsHint: The backup does not contain plugin packages. Review the names and sources of missing plugins before allowing installation.
setupTitle: Set up this machine from a Gist
newMachineTitle: Using this on a new machine
newMachineStep1: Install Config sync Plus in the target profile.
newMachineStep2: Enter the trusted backup’s Gist ID or link and supply a GitHub token with Gist access.
newMachineStep3: Choose “Preview restore” and review file changes, plugin sources and items that need manual setup.
newMachineStep4: Confirm only if you trust the plan. Review the results, handle pending builds separately and restart DSH as indicated.
tokenHelp: Use the token field, DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN on the host, or a signed-in gh CLI. Do not share tokens or Gist links.
